text:
Type: set of nine black and white photo prints
Use: creating a gallery wall above a sofa, a desk or a bed; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: industrial, modern, contemporary
Materials: printed photographic images
Colors: black, white, shades of grey
Shape: nine rectangular prints in mixed sizes showing a city skyline, skyscrapers and suspension bridges, arranged as a grid collage, graphic and high contrast
Feel: urban, dramatic, sleek, moody
Goes with: black frames, grey or white walls, leather, metal; industrial, modern or loft-style rooms
